calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label, period_end_date
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
ORDER BY period_end_date DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT MAX(week_ending_date) as last_stock_week
FROM fact_stock_week

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, d.fiscal_period_label, dd.period_end_date
FROM dim_date d
JOIN ref_fiscal_calendar dd ON d.fiscal_year = dd.fiscal_year AND d.fiscal_period = dd.fiscal_period
WHERE d.calendar_date = '2026-10-04'

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  MAX(d.calendar_date) as last_date,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fs.week_ending_date) as weeks_of_stock_data
FROM dim_date d
LEFT JOIN fact_stock_week fs ON DATE_TRUNC('day', d.calendar_date) = fs.week_ending_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period IN (5, 6)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period DESC

SELECT 
  dp.category,
  SUM(fs.closing_units) as total_units,
  SUM(fs.closing_value) as total_value_eur
FROM fact_stock_week fs
JOIN dim_product dp ON fs.product_key = dp.product_key
WHERE fs.week_ending_date = '2026-09-27'
GROUP BY dp.category
ORDER BY dp.category

SELECT 
  dp.category,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d.fiscal_week) as num_weeks,
  SUM(fsl.quantity) as total_units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON fsl.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 5
GROUP BY dp.category
ORDER BY dp.category

calls.statement:
WITH stock_at_period_end AS (
  SELECT 
    dp.category,
    SUM(fs.closing_units) as closing_stock_units
  FROM fact_stock_week fs
  JOIN dim_product dp ON fs.product_key = dp.product_key
  WHERE fs.week_ending_date = '2026-09-27'
  GROUP BY dp.category
),
period_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    dp.category,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.fiscal_week) as num_weeks,
    SUM(fsl.quantity) as total_units_sold
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON fsl.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 5
  GROUP BY dp.category
)
SELECT 
  s.category,
  s.closing_stock_units,
  ps.total_units_sold,
  ps.num_weeks,
  ROUND(ps.total_units_sold::DECIMAL / ps.num_weeks, 2) as avg_weekly_sales,
  CASE 
    WHEN ps.total_units_sold > 0 THEN ROUND(s.closing_stock_units::DECIMAL / (ps.total_units_sold::DECIMAL / ps.num_weeks), 2)
    ELSE NULL
  END as weeks_of_cover
FROM stock_at_period_end s
LEFT JOIN period_sales ps ON s.category = ps.category
WHERE s.category != 'ZZ Test'
ORDER BY s.category

calls.statement:
WITH stock_at_period_end AS (
  SELECT 
    dp.category,
    SUM(fs.closing_units) as closing_stock_units
  FROM fact_stock_week fs
  JOIN dim_product dp ON fs.product_key = dp.product_key
  WHERE fs.week_ending_date = '2026-09-27'
  GROUP BY dp.category
),
period_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    dp.category,
    SUM(fsl.quantity)::DECIMAL / COUNT(DISTINCT d.fiscal_week) as avg_weekly_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON fsl.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 5
  GROUP BY dp.category
)
SELECT 
  s.category,
  ROUND(s.closing_stock_units / ps.avg_weekly_sales, 2) as weeks_of_cover
FROM stock_at_period_end s
JOIN period_sales ps ON s.category = ps.category
WHERE s.category != 'ZZ Test'
ORDER BY s.category
